title: Proof Item
description: A substantiable claim about xLoop delivery. Governed by 08_governance/evidence_rules.md. Default public_use is UNKNOWN, which must be treated as INTERNAL. A proof item is public only if it appears in 06_proof/proof_library.md.

client_name.description: Internal only unless public_reference_permitted is true

client_anonymised_descriptor.description: The exact approved public wording, e.g. 'a 30 MW wind IPP'

permission_evidence.description: Where the permission is recorded. Absence means no permission.

measured_results.description: Every numeric result must carry source, period and method. A result missing any of the three is not publishable.

third_party_ownership.description: Set whenever partner or licensed technology is involved. If xLoop did not do the work, xLoop does not claim the outcome.

evidence_grade.description: A=named+measured+approved; B=named+measured, not approved; C=anonymised+described; D=capability only; E=unsourced; X=may belong to a third party, do not publish.
